title: Congress Lobbying × Trades Overlap — Output
description: Overlap records land in the default dataset (one item per member/quarter/sector overlap, with full trade and lobbying evidence). Every run also writes a RUN_SUMMARY record to the key-value store with coverage stats, unmapped codes/tickers, and source freshness — including runs that find zero overlaps.

overlaps.title: Overlap records
overlaps.description: One record per (member, quarter, sector) overlap: member identity, quarter, sector, mapping rule id and confidence, trades[], lobbying[], committees[], overlap_type (committee_match / sector_match_only), and disclosure_lag_days. Each record is traceable to filing IDs and source URLs.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Coverage report for the run: quarters covered, members scanned, overlap counts by type, every unmapped issue code / ticker / committee / member name, and source freshness timestamps. Written on every run, including zero-overlap runs.
